answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The shale of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution. Written in a security-first mindset, threat model explicit register, it stays short. A crystal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ridge of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
